germany.apply: Winter semester: 15 July at most universities (some 31 May). Summer semester: 15 January.
germany.months: 6 to 9 months from applying to starting
start_early: Required for Indian students and needed before the visa. Start it the moment the shortlist is set, not after the offer.
Its deadline is the SAME DAY as the application deadline, so beginning it in June for a 15 July deadline is already too late.
Book the day admission lands. Availability, not paperwork, is the bottleneck.
germany.miss_it: Miss 15 July and the next intake is April, or October a year later.

netherlands.apply: Numerus fixus programmes: 15 January, statutory, no extension. Everything else for non-EU: 1 April or 1 May depending on the university.
netherlands.months: 5 to 8 months from applying to starting
start_early: Decide on fixus programmes by December
The 15 January wall is the single biggest cause of a lost year. A student who waits for Indian board results in May has already missed it.
The university will not file your IND application until tuition plus the living-cost guarantee (EUR 13,569 for 2026) has cleared.
netherlands.miss_it: Miss 15 January on a fixus programme and you wait a full year. There is no late round.

singapore.apply: Roughly October to March, per university (NUS and NTU differ by a few weeks).
singapore.months: 5 to 10 months from applying to starting
start_early: Indian Standard XII is direct entry. No equivalence body, no foundation year.
Be ready to upload board results within 3 days
Both universities deem the application incomplete if the Standard XII slip is not uploaded within 3 days of release. No appeal.
singapore.miss_it: The Tuition Grant signing window is only days long and falls in mid-September. Miss it and the family pays non-subsidised fees for the whole degree.

australia.apply: February intake: July to September of the previous year. July intake: roughly March to May.
australia.months: 5 to 7 months from applying to starting
start_early: Assessors look for a traceable balance, not a lump sum that appeared last week.
Remote-proctored tests including IELTS Online are NOT accepted for the visa, even where the university accepted one.
australia.miss_it: Lodge the visa on or after 15 November: Ministerial Direction 115's priority year resets and processing drops from 9-12 weeks to 1-4.

canada.apply: 15 January for most Ontario programmes (a few 1 February or 1 March). Alberta and UBC vary.
canada.months: 7 to 8 months from applying to starting
start_early: CBSE Applied Mathematics silently disqualifies a student from business, engineering and science at Toronto, Waterloo and their peers.
CAD 23,448 for a single applicant outside Quebec, and it re-indexes every 1 September, mid-season.
India is a designated country. Skipping it costs 4 to 6 weeks mid-processing.
canada.miss_it: The PAL only starts after the deposit clears, and the permit needs the PAL. A late deposit compresses everything downstream.

italy.apply: Universitaly pre-enrolment opens in spring. Entrance tests have fixed sittings: IMAT in September, CEnT-S and TOLC on published dates.
italy.months: 6 to 9 months from applying to starting
start_early: HRD attestation, MEA apostille, then CIMEA or a Declaration of Value
4 to 8 weeks, plus up to 90 days
This chain must be COMPLETE before the entrance test, not after the result. It is the real constraint in Italy and the reason to start a year out.
Each university fixes a separate non-EU seat count by 31 December and ranks those applicants separately. Odds are not the headline class size.
italy.miss_it: Pre-enrolment validation is now capped at quota +20% and suspends when a university hits it. Late pre-enrolment can be refused outright.

spain.apply: Private universities: rolling from November. Public universities: UNEDasiss opens 4 February, PCE exams late May, preinscripción June to early July.
spain.months: Private 6 to 8 months · Public 8 to 10 months from applying to starting
start_early: The legal limit is 3 months from a complete file; in practice far longer, with no way to accelerate it. File it by November for a September start.
There is NO PCE exam centre in India. The nearest listed centres include Abu Dhabi and Doha, which suits Gulf-based students and forces a flight for everyone else.
spain.miss_it: In Catalonia a volante is not enough for the June call — you drop to September and are last in place allocation.
